n61da728bf8.headline: "Low cost" effect: a remís to Ezeiza now costs more than flying to Rosario and Córdoba
n61da728bf8.summary: Domestic flight tickets in Argentina have decreased by 6.6% this year, while transport costs to airports have increased at inflation rate.
n61da728bf8.why: Airfare pricing trends affect consumer travel demand and airline profitability in Argentina's domestic aviation market.

n9c18301fcc.summary: The beneficiation factory in Ak-Tyuz, Kyrgyzstan, resumed operations following a workers' strike.
n9c18301fcc.why: Mining and metallurgical factories are critical to Kyrgyzstan's economy; labor disruptions affect production and exports.

nf95536b8f4.headline: Pay TV prices in Mexico rise, mobile telephony prices fall
nf95536b8f4.summary: Mexico's National Institute of Statistics and Geography reported that pay TV prices increased in early June, whereas mobile telephony prices declined.
nf95536b8f4.why: Changes in consumer prices for telecom services affect inflation and consumer spending patterns in Mexico.

n258ad56d99.headline: Ringgit in recovery mode | New Straits Times
n258ad56d99.summary: The Malaysian ringgit is forecasted to strengthen further in the coming weeks due to the country's solid economic fundamentals.
n258ad56d99.why: Currency strength reflects economic health and affects trade competitiveness and foreign investment flows in Malaysia.
n258ad56d99.why_moved: Positive economic indicators boost investor confidence in the ringgit, driving its recovery.

n6af479fb14.headline: The state deals – the mafia is angry - WELT
n6af479fb14.summary: Marijuana will in future be available from pharmacies in Uruguay, according to Die Welt. The measure is intended to remove the business basis of drug cartels in the country.
n6af479fb14.why: State-regulated cannabis markets are a developing legal sector that changes the economics of illegal supply chains.

nb73eee6a95.headline: Daniel Zamfir, legislative project to limit IFNs. Huge news for hundreds of thousands of Romanians
nb73eee6a95.summary: Senator Daniel Zamfir and lawyer Piperea submitted three draft laws to Parliament aimed at limiting IFNs, Romania's non-bank lenders. The article describes the measures as significant for many Romanians.
nb73eee6a95.why: Non-bank financial institutions (IFNs) are lenders outside the banking system, and tighter rules on them affect consumer credit and the business models of listed lenders.
